topic: The baffling cases of acquired savant syndrome: ordinary people who gained extraordinary genius skills after severe brain injury.
title: His Brain Injury Made Him a GENIUS. 🤯🧠
script: Imagine: an ordinary person, then a freak head injury. Suddenly, they're a mathematical genius, a master painter, or a musical prodigy... overnight. This isn't a movie – it's acquired savant syndrome. Trauma *unlocking* genius. How does the brain hold such hidden potential? Scientists are still baffled. Your mind is an enigma.
